name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.LinearHop.card_strict_steps_le_finrank
title: A monotone chain of subspaces has at most dim V strict steps
statement: Let V be a finite-dimensional vector space over a field K and R_0 <= R_1 <= R_2 <= ... a monotone chain of subspaces of V. For every n, the number of indices t < n with R_t != R_{t+1} is at most dim V. In the linear-hop barrier for data-only witness-indexed WE hybrids (note pq-we-linear-hop-barrier), R_t is the span of the ciphertext shifts (or re-randomization directions) applied by the first t hops; a witness whose decryption functional is untouched by all earlier hops and touched by its own hop forces a strict step, so at most dim V = N witnesses can be killed that way.
